payload.objective: Introduce a general trusted multi-source artifact path and prove it with Hermes without trusting third-party forks.
boundaries: Local code, focused tests, Debug build, Meizu 18 crash check, and local phase commits only. Do not push, release, create cloud accounts, or create remote buckets.
Validate only one concrete fallback effect plus the final true-device crash check; no broad suites.
Official upstream remains the authority. Mirrors may only transport bytes that match a pinned digest; no Hermes or device special cases.

payload.title: native trusted multi-source download
payload.objective: Carry ordered download sources through the Android native provider, fall back only on transport failure, and accept the result only after the manifest digest matches.
acceptance: A focused contract test proves an unavailable primary source falls through to a secondary source carrying the same pinned artifact identity.
The Debug APK builds and cold-starts on Meizu 18 without a crash.
invariants: No source may bypass digest validation, and existing candidate installation semantics remain unchanged.
payload.nextAction: Inspect the native download provider contract and its focused tests before editing.

payload.summary: Ordered HTTPS sources now use native fallback under one pinned digest; unpinned mirrors are rejected, the selected host is reported, and Hermes install.sh is pinned to the verified official SHA-256.
remainingRisks: No domestic object-storage endpoint has been provisioned, so Hermes remains official-single-source until an authorized OSS/COS/OBS artifact URL exists.

payload.name: trusted source fallback and device crash gate
payload.summary: Focused tests proved primary transport failure selects the digest-pinned mirror and rejects unpinned mirrors; Hermes official installer digest was independently fetched twice; assembleDebug passed and Meizu 18 cold-started as pid 10739 without crash output.

payload.nextAction: Provision an authorized immutable OSS/COS/OBS artifact URL before adding the first real domestic Hermes source.
